stages.name: Now Charging
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Power Plant, increases the drone recovery rate by <@cc.vup>+10%</>

stages.name: Now Under Maintenance
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Power Plant, if another <$cc.g.laterano><@cc.kw>Laterano</></> Operator is assigned to a Power Plant, drone charging speed <@cc.vup>+5%</>

stages.name: Pay-Per-Confession I
stages.description: The first time blocking an enemy, gains 2 DP and puts the blocked enemy to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for 5s

stages.description: The first time blocking an enemy, gains 2 DP and puts the blocked enemy to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for 6s

stages.name: Pay-Per-Confession IV
stages.description: The first time blocking an enemy, gains 3 DP and puts the blocked enemy to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for 7s

stages.name: Pay-Per-Confession V
